card.name: Words before regions beyond one's own
card.fires_on: Small words (a space, "other", "from", "to", "the") right before a place or region contrast, such as out-of-state, other states, the North, or selected jurisdictions versus the whole nation.

modes.label: Other states or outside areas
modes.description: Linking word before a mention of places other than the home area.
modes.example: Even Democratic leaders in New York, California and<< other>> states have sought to limit pensions for state

modes.label: Moving between regions
modes.description: Word before a region such as the North, after a move from the South or from outside.
modes.example: Southern blacks moving to<< the>> North early in the 20th

modes.label: Some places versus the whole nation
modes.description: Word or space before a jurisdiction or percentage contrasting some places with the entire country.
modes.example: Voting Rights Act unfairly applies only to<< selected>> jurisdictions rather than the entire nation.

card.writes: It pushes toward nationwide and regional Chinese terms like 全国 and 南方, and away from foreign or international terms.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a region or other-place reference, as in moving between states or applying nationwide versus locally.
